releaseNotes:
1. Cash & UPI Privacy: PlanX Copilot completely hidden on Cash & UPI screen.
2. Role-Based Tender View: Cashier/Staff view strictly limited to their own shift tender & drops; Supervisors/Admin see consolidated store totals.
3. Immutable Audit Trail: Every transaction, stock adjustment, wastage, purchase intake, and user change logs verifiable timestamp and operator name.
4. PlanX Audit Queries: Supervisors & Admins can query 'Who made transaction...', 'Who recorded wastage...', or 'Transactions by [name]'.
5. Shift Handover & Auto Z-Report: Logging in as a new user automatically logs out previous operator and records their official shift Z-Report.
